Theorem thm:p03-fol-zero-one (lines 25-33, status cited=Fagin1976): for every first-order tau-sentence phi, with A_n uniform among labeled tau-structures on [n], lim Pr[A_n |= phi] exists and is 0 or 1. Its vocabulary assumption (finite, purely relational, positive arity, no constants or functions) and distribution assumption (uniform over labeled structures on [n]) are the chapter conventions of lines 14-20, which say they are part of the law. Lines 35-40 give the attribution (Glebskii-Kogan-Liogon'kii-Talanov; Fagin) with citations GlebskiiEtAl1969, Fagin1976 and Libkin2004, all present in bib/handbook.bib. They also state the boundaries: the law does not decide finite validity, a built-in order or successor can destroy it, and constants or function symbols fall outside it. The status is cited, not proved, so no unproved dependency is presented as proved. This meets the treatment-S standing.
